I spent the 4th day walking around Myeondong and buying some stuff and souvenirs for my family and friends. I went to the airport at 3 PM since my flight was at 5 PM.

"How lucky I am!" he said. "I found a purse. Judging by its weight, it must be full of gold and money inside!".
